company.name: AfterQuery
company.shortDescription: AfterQuery is an AI data company that builds expert-level datasets to help train and improve AI models.
company.description: AfterQuery is an artificial intelligence research and data platform focused on creating high-quality, human-generated datasets to improve AI model performance. It provides specialized training data and empirical research initiatives designed to help organizations build and fine-tune advanced machine learning systems, particularly for complex, real-world professional tasks. The platform emphasizes sourcing data that cannot be easily obtained online or generated synthetically, enabling more accurate and reliable AI outputs. It also connects a network of vetted experts and professionals who contribute domain-specific knowledge to support AI development and evaluation. Through its solutions, AfterQuery aims to advance the capabilities of AI by combining rigorous research with curated human expertise.
